title: Choose the visual world for christianonovo.com
question: The roll assigned the Uli Cipher. Keep it, take The Record or the Select Rail, or re-roll.

options.label: Uli Cipher
options.lineage: Igbo uli line art and ideographic marks, read as encoding
options.thesis: A record written in his own marks: each piece of work gets a glyph, and the twin decodes them.
options.viewport: Serif headline left, live twin input under it, a glyph index of four works right; one drawn line joins nav, headline and input.
options.risk: Cultural motif can read as costume unless Christian authors or approves the marks; Ekpe nsibidi stays out.

raised.raise: About opens on one real portrait of Christian, cropped hard, not a polite headshot.
Each glyph is a summary face that opens in place into its case study.
Camwood over indigo overprints to a third tone, used only for the selected state.
Quiet at rest: the line draws only in answer to the visitor, then settles.
The palette follows London's hour (indigo night, cotton day), overridable in Cmd+K.

options.label: The Record
options.thesis: The site is a line-numbered transcript; every visitor question goes on the record.
materials: transcript sheet on a graphite desk
options.viewport: Name and nav left, a transcript sheet centre whose last Q line is the live twin input, exhibits in the margin.
options.risk: Familiar: it is chat-shaped, and the closest to what an AI-portfolio run usually lands on.

options.label: Select Rail
options.thesis: Career and work strung on one perforated rail; the frame you stopped on is flagged when you return.
options.viewport: Orange rail across the top third with roles and builds as frames, a punched window with name and twin input, older sites on pins.
options.case: Clearest navigation of the three, but founders don't identify with an editing bench.
options.risk: Black with orange sits close to the black-and-one-accent default unless orange owns a third of every screen.

options.label: Movida Cover
options.thesis: The site as a scattered magazine cover.
options.viewport: Cropped portrait under a hand-inked masthead.
options.risk: Scatter navigation fails a founder in a hurry.
options.kept: Courage of a hard-cropped real portrait.

options.label: Window-box Shelf
options.thesis: Projects as boxed sets with lids.
options.kept: Summary face that opens in place to detail.

options.label: Risograph
options.kept: Honest overprint: two inks make a third.

options.label: Plankton Wake
options.viewport: Dark field lit by your cursor.
options.risk: The glowing-AI cliché the brief bans.
options.kept: Stillness at rest; motion only answers the visitor.

options.label: Rain-night City
options.thesis: Skyline bands by hour and weather.
options.kept: Time-indexed palette tied to the real hour.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A premium dark founder site: big name, short bio, bento grid of work, chat bubble.
canonCard.viewport: Large name over a one-line bio, CTA pair, bento grid below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other engineer's site by design.
